subject: Access artifact curation: SAML assertion samples + role snapshot handoff
messages:
From: Emily Rios <audit@nebulafin.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: audit@nebulafin.com
Date: 2027-11-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: SAML assertion samples and SCIM delta for access controls (SOC 2)

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for taking this through. As part of NebulaFin's SOC 2 evidence collection for our SIG/CAIQ review, we need the following artifacts focused on access control and provisioning for the Redwood tenancy that houses our account:

- Two representative SAML assertion samples (raw XML) for successful logins that include NameID, eduPersonPrincipalName / email, and the role/group attribute. Please redact user identifiers if needed but preserve attribute names and values schema.
- SCIM delta export covering 2027-10-01 through 2027-10-31 showing provisioning events (create/update/deactivate) for user accounts that correspond to NebulaFin.
- Current role mapping spreadsheet (export from your RBAC store) including role id, role name, attached policies, and list/count of assigned principals.
- Service account inventory (non-human) with owner and last-used timestamp.

Can you confirm expected delivery date? Ideally we'd receive artifacts by end of next week (2027-11-10). If any items need an NDAs or a secure transfer channel, let me know and we can accommodate.

Thanks — Emily Rios
Lead Auditor, NebulaFin Compliance

[Attachment: audit-checklist_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Emily Rios <audit@nebulafin.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-03T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML assertion samples and SCIM delta for access controls (SOC 2)

Hi Emily —

Appreciate the clear list. We can provide everything requested by 2027-11-10 EOD. Plan:

1) I will coordinate RBAC/role-export and service-account inventory with Laura.
2) Hannah will extract SCIM delta and include a CSV with event_type, user_id (redacted), timestamp, and operation.
3) We will provide two raw SAML assertion samples (redacted for PII) and a short readme describing the extraction method and the attribute map.

We will deliver artifacts via a secure transfer link and paste the HubSpot evidence ID in the thread when uploaded. If NebulaFin prefers a signed DSA or separate encrypted container, let me know.

Action owners: Laura (role export + service accounts), Hannah (SCIM export + SAML samples). I will review and do the bundle handoff.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Security Liaison, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: internal-evidence-plan.md (text/markdown) — internal only]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-04T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: SAML assertion samples and SCIM delta for access controls (SOC 2) — action items

Hannah / Laura — copying our next steps inline so we have clear ownership:

- Hannah: please extract SCIM delta CSV for 2027-10-01 -> 2027-10-31. Columns: event_type, scim_id, external_id (redact if necessary), operation, timestamp, source (UI/API), notes. Put .csv on the secure transfer folder and mark rows tied to NebulaFin.
- Hannah: pull two SAML assertion samples for NebulaFin users that show the full attribute set (NameID, email, role/group attribute). Strip or hash any raw user identifiers; leave attribute keys and sample values intact.
- Laura: export current RBAC role mapping (xlsx) with role_id, role_name, description, attached_scopes/policies, number_of_principals. Also export service-account-inventory with owner, created_at, last_used_at, and linked projects.

Hannah — if the SCIM extraction uses the /internal/scim/deltas endpoint, use this query (example):
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_TOKEN" "https://internal-api.redwood.local/scim/deltas?start=2027-10-01&end=2027-10-31&tenant=nebulafin" -o scim-delta-2027-10.csv

Log any redaction decisions in the readme. I put a placeholder Drive folder in related_links (secure transfer) and the HubSpot ticket HS-43219 for the NebulaFin engagement.

Thanks — Karthik

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-08T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SAML assertion samples and SCIM delta for access controls (SOC 2) — uploads

Quick update — artifacts uploaded to the secure transfer folder and I attached small stubs here:

- scim-delta-sample-2027-10-01_to_2027-10-31.csv (CSV, 12k rows, redactions: external_id hashed)
- saml-assertion-sample-edu.xml (two XML samples; PII hashed, attributes preserved)
- role-map-export-20271110.xlsx (export snapshot)
- service-account-inventory-20271110.csv (inventory stub)

Notes: one noisy tenant sync produced ~400 transient deprovision events on 2027-10-12 — I flagged those in the CSV notes column. The SAML assertions include an attribute named "groups" carrying our RBAC role names; I left the mapping in the readme.

I will follow with a short MD readme describing the redaction method and exact API calls used.

— Hannah
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: scim-delta-sample-2027-10-01_to_2027-10-31.csv, saml-assertion-sample-edu.xml, role-map-export-20271110.xlsx, service-account-inventory-20271110.csv]

From: Emily Rios <audit@nebulafin.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: audit@nebulafin.com
Date: 2027-11-10T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML assertion samples and SCIM delta for access controls (SOC 2)

Karthik / team —

Received the bundle and reviewed the samples. Good coverage — only ask: can you provide one additional SAML assertion that includes the role attribute populated with an admin-level role (we need to validate attribute mapping for privileged access). If you can drop that by EOD today, we can close this evidence item in our tracker (HS-43219).

If sending another sample is not possible due to privacy policies, please provide a brief A/R explaining why and include a screenshot of the role mapping view from the console showing the admin role and its policy attachments.

Thanks — Emily

On a process note: the HubSpot evidence record ID HS-43219 is linked to our SOC workplan; once we mark this item closed I'll attach it to our report.
